advances: A local necessary equation at a canonical cap, conditional on stationary covectors.
author: PK-research-agent
proof:
Write the cap's parameter stationarity as the sum of the objective covector, the budget covector, the negative contact covectors and the metric multiplier $\sigma$ times the differential of $(u^\top A u-1)/2$. Its own-fiber objective differential is $(h\Phi/c)Dc+(k\Phi/H)DH$ by the strict simplex calculation on that fiber alone. Here $DH$ pairs with the feature $(z,v,-1)$. The coarea feature $Dc$ has continuous component equal to its mass times $g$, since the section centroid has barycentric coordinates all equal to $1/(d+1)$. The contact features also have continuous component $g$ times their mass. Subtracting the threshold balance times $g$ from the continuous balance thus leaves $\alpha_0(k\Phi/H)(v-g)+\sigma Au=0$. Evaluate stationarity in the direction of common rescaling of the entire affine margin. The mass is invariant, all positively weighted contacts have zero margin, the objective derivative is $k\Phi$, and the metric differential is $u^\top Au=1$. This gives $\sigma=-\alpha_0 k\Phi$ and the claimed condition.

If $\beta_i$ is the barycentric gradient and $w_i=v_i-g$, then $u_i=\beta_i/\sqrt{\beta_i^\top A\beta_i}$ and $H_i=d/((d+1)\sqrt{\beta_i^\top A\beta_i})$. The equation is therefore exactly the geometric covariance equation of aaef76e8cbfd4465, after multiplying its displayed equation by $d+1$. Its hypotheses about the simplex and positive definite matrix are met; that equivalence is purely algebraic, independent of the hinge objective used to obtain it there.
statement: For a canonical centroid vertex cap of a simplex fiber with apex $v$, centroid $g$ and apex margin $H=u\cdot(v-g)>0$, fix a positive definite matrix $A$ and impose $u^\top A u=1$. Consider the cap's stationary fixed-source cover equations for a smooth homogeneous cap-moment cost $\Phi$ of margin degree $k$, with objective multiplier $\alpha_0$. Assume the other fibers contribute zero cap mass and zero combined multiplied section covector to these equations, and all positively weighted contacts of this cap are at its own centroid. If $\alpha_0 k\Phi\ne0$, then $v-g=H A u$. For all canonical cap types of this simplex the geometric equations hold exactly when $A$ is a positive scalar multiple of its uniform volume covariance.
title: A quadratic metric condition for stationary homogeneous simplex caps
